description.value:
Designate the creature you're targeting as your charge, as from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.52QyoGaysrfBOy5H]{Witch's Charge}. It gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ugeStF0Rj8phBPWL]{Effect: Witch's Charge}, and anyone else who has your charge loses it.

Target one creature, then use this action (post it to chat). With @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4IeAAmx2vZEHmRLX]{Witch's Communion}, you can target up to as many creatures as your Intelligence modifier: they become your charges. You normally designate your charges during your daily preparations.
